title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-11
lineage: Akai GX636 direct tape head output  > Bottlehead tube tape pre w/a pair of Tesla tubes circa 1960  > Apogee Mini Me 24/96  > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering  > FLAC
source: SBD MR Technics RS 1506 @7.5 ips > Revox A77(Bob Menke)@7.5 ips > Revox A77(Pat Lee)@7.5 ips

ai_review.summary: High‑energy performance with a scorching Spanish Jam and Greg Allman's surprise Lovelight, but the recording cuts off abruptly before Shine On Me.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the wild, busy jams—especially a hot Spanish Jam flavored by Peter Green and a cool Lovelight featuring guest vocalist Greg Allman. Pigpen’s hype and Phil Lesh’s bass‑driven interlude add extra excitement, though the soundboard ends suddenly before the song Shine On Me, limiting the listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are enthusiastic about the musical performance (average 4.7 stars) but note a major recording flaw—the abrupt ending—so the overall rating is slightly lowered.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific comments on clarity, but reviewers warn of an abrupt cut‑off before Shine On Me, indicating a recording issue.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as wildly busy with dense improvisation; Phil's bass line creates a Caution‑Jam‑like bridge, and Pigpen keeps the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's bass line in the middle of the jam is highlighted as a key moment.
